description: This Java class defines a REST controller named AnalyticsController that exposes endpoints for retrieving AI/heuristic-based analytics insights at an organizational level and per employee. It uses Spring Boot annotations for REST mapping, security, and API documentation.

classes.name: AnalyticsController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for organizational and employee analytics insights, secured by role-based access control and documented with Swagger annotations.

methods.name: overall
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve overall analytics insights over a specified number of days.

methods.name: employee
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve analytics insights for a specific employee over a specified number of days.
